method: Each bounded individual source JPEG was actually inspected; native lines compared. Only prose, section/paragraph boundaries and source ownership were checked.

findings.finding: Title page: Following the Trail of Data, Control #8362 and February22,2010. Bottom page1 is furniture. None is summary prose.

Printed Summary Statement heading followed by exactly three technical summary paragraphs. Both Control #8362 and page2 are running furniture. Printed complied/asess remain author wording. Technical summary ends with 'the paper.' on this page.

Printed Executive Summary, salutation, four complete paragraphs, then start of a fifth. Native blocks split each physical line in double-spaced prose; source indentation establishes paragraph starts at natives3,6,15,20,24. Last line ends 'In addi-' and continues at page4. The phrase printed 'drop off in' lacks a space in native ligature extraction; restore only that spacing. Physical wrap loca-/tions joins locations.

Starts 'tion to the aforementioned...' continuing the previous page's last paragraph, not a new section. Then efficiency paragraph, operational output-to-action paragraph, and closing 'We wish you luck in your investigations.' All belong to Executive Summary. Physical wraps run-/ning and com-/puters are discretionary. The text states 4-hour/million-point and seconds/ten-thousand-point timings as author claims; no runtime or model validation performed.
Contents starts a separate page after the executive-summary closing; no continued summary prose. Contents entries and printed page number retained separately.

required_repairs: Recognize literal Summary Statement title without relabeling author text
Keep Executive Summary through page4 closing
Restore the single cross-page addition word and paragraph without hiding either source fragment
Restore only checked within-page discretionary wraps and one missing prose space
remaining_uncertainties: Physical pages6–33 and complete body mapping have not been reviewed here. Whole-paper acceptance remains pending.
